text:
mai: Quick heads-up — onboarding run for osprey-slim-v1 (quant: q5k, fallback int8) showed a weird delta on vertical subtitle-type data + RTL-mixed lines. BLEU -5.2 on smoke set. Anyone free to triage?
henry: Can you share the exact eval incantation and one raw example where it fails?
sana: Also which tokenizer variant was used by the q5k build? fast-tokenizer-v1 vs v2 can behave differently for ruby/zwj.
mai: Eval: ```./dev/eval_local.sh --model osprey-slim-v1 --quant q5k --dataset data/vertical_subs/mini-500 --metrics bleu chrf --seed 7 --commit f9b2a7```
mai: Failing sample (source OCR-like): "年末，東京<ruby>ことわ</ruby>
[EN] Arrival (east)"
mai: Float output: "年末, 東京<ruby>ことわ</ruby>
Arrival (east)"
mai: q5k output: "年末, 東京
Arrival (east)"  (ruby reading stripped)
li: I also saw samples with Arabic parentheses flipping side after detok: source had "اب (test) جد" but q5k detok produced "اب )test( جد" — looks like bracket mirror + space shuffle.
henry: That bracket flip screams bidi reorder + a later whitespace normalization step. Could be our detok-run sequence: we run bidi-resolve -> merge-spaces -> apply-ruby-unwrap. If quant branch reorders those steps, it can lose context.
sana: Which commit of tokenizers is on the q5k wheel? We had q5k build using tokenizers@4.3.0 and float builds using tokenizers@4.1.2 per the last packaging change.
akiko: @sana please open a unit test for: 1) ruby-preserve-roundtrip, 2) rtl-bracket-position-stable, 3) newline-in-vertical-kept. Add to ci/regressions/locale-smoke. I'll also check compilation flags that might fold zero-width joiners during kernel fusions (we saw an optimisation recently that strips zwj in some tokenization paths).
ci-bot: Build 5592 started for osprey-slim-v1-q5k (artifact id a5592).
mai: Immediate plan: 1) repro on pinned tokenizer 4.1.2, 2) run Python detok util locally with verbose steps, 3) generate diff for 200-sample mini-set, 4) run int8 fallback for cross-check. Aim by EOD PST.
henry: If pinning fixes it, we should add tokenizer_id to model-metadata so quant commits can't inadvertently upgrade it. Also add a small eval checkpoint in the onboard checklist.
sana: Quick patch: I patched wheel to use tokenizers@4.1.2 and kicked off a local smoke. Will report token counts and one-liners in 30m.
mai: Thanks — ping here when you have the diff URL. Also adding a note to the onboard issue: https://issues/internal/ML-1189 (will attach repro).
henry: FYI, add a short script to reproduce detok ordering so ops can run it in stg before canary.
mai: will do.
